mapper.select: SELECT m.name AS medicineName, SUM(pi.quantity) AS consumeCount, SUM(pi.quantity * pi.unit_price) AS consumeAmount FROM medicine m LEFT JOIN prescription_item pi ON m.id = pi.medicine_id AND pi.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN prescription p ON pi.prescription_id = p.id AND p.deleted=0 AND DATE(p.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE m.deleted=0 GROUP BY m.id,m.name
